name: a lucid dream

phase_0.boundary_condition: The circadian rhythm threshold and sleep architecture cycle.

VINIT.justification: The pre-narrative state of sleep where the ego dissolves into unstructured noise.

TANCH.justification: The definitive termination of the dream state that collapses the simulation.

AFWD.justification: The forward progression of the dreaming mind into a complex environmental model.

AREV.justification: A descent from higher dream clarity back into lower-order simulation or confusion.

CLINK.justification: The composition of discrete imagery into a coherent, navigable spatio-temporal sequence.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition event where the dreamer identifies as a dreamer within the dream.

FSPLIT.justification: The bifurcation point where the dreamer tests the environment to determine if they are awake or dreaming.

FFUSE.justification: The consolidation of the reality check results back into a unified sensory experience.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative determination that the environment is internally generated and controllable.

EVALF.justification: The failure to recognize the dream state, leading to a return to passive narrative immersion.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of dream imagery and external sensory input during the waking transition.

IFIX.justification: The permanent preservation of the dream experience into post-arousal episodic memory.

phase_3.void_description: The unorganized information noise of sleep onset.
phase_3.true_description: Active volitional control and high-fidelity environmental resolution.
phase_3.false_description: Passive yielding to randomized narrative fragments without agency.
phase_3.both_description: The state of knowing one is dreaming while remaining unable to alter the narrative flow.

steps.domain_action: Departure from waking state and entry into the uninitialized sensory void of sleep.
Propagation of the initial hypnagogic imagery into a stable environmental model.
Chaining of sensory inputs to form a consistent dream locale and narrative starting point.
Implementation of a reality check to bifurcate perception into waking or dreaming categories.
Confirmation of the dreaming state through successful critical observation.
The dreamer identifies their self-as-observer within the constructed environment.
Reintegration of the awareness of dreaming into the persistent environmental simulation.
Intentional transformation of the dreamscape through volitional agency.
Maintaining narrative stability while exerting control over oneiric laws.
Encounter with an externalized dream character or unexpected environmental shift.
Temporary loss of lucidity as the dreamer becomes absorbed by the new narrative lure.
Regression into a non-lucid state where the dream architecture dictates behavior.
Restoration of the unified dream stream despite the loss of critical awareness.
Exposure to an external alarm sound that blends with the dream narrative concurrently.
Mental fixation of the dream narrative into memory just prior to the collapse of the dream.
Definitive termination of the REM cycle and return to waking physiological constraints.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The thalamocortical loop translating neurological noise into visual and tactile imagery.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Neurochemical modulation via acetylcholine and serotonin levels between sleep stages.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The hippocampus functioning as a buffer for the dreaming episode before waking transfer.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The brainstem governing the transitions between NREM and REM cycles.
phase_5.alfs_store: The somatic and autobiographical repository used to populate dream content.

phase_6.cycle_cost: ATP consumption and neurochemical turnover within the prefrontal cortex.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A state of NREM-3 physiological restoration with low metabolic demand.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of REM-high arousal with increased metabolic and neural activity.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The dream state uses existing internal information to simulate reality without external input.
